comment: Meta screens built engine-free (W-16 journal; later W-18 settings, W-05 prologue, W-22 progression, W-12 armoury, W-17 piles): the keys this build adds to the profile's run record, wire values, placeholders and formats. strings/meta.en.json keys are generated as MetaStringKeys.

keySets.name: MetaKeys
keySets.doc: Keys this build reads or adds: the run record's killer, duration and deck (D-148), and the journal's rail ids.

keySets.name: MetaValues
keySets.doc: Wire values of the meta views.

keySets.name: MetaFormats
keySets.doc: String-key formats of catalog names the meta views read (<prefix>.<id>.<field>).

stringTables.name: MetaStringKeys
stringTables.doc: Meta screen string keys (strings/meta.en.json): W-16 journal.
